newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: CRICKET-GRIQUALAND W. 263-7 AT CLOSE V W.PROVINCE.
newsitem.headline: CRICKET-GRIQUALAND W. 263-7 AT CLOSE V W.PROVINCE.

text.p: Martyn Gidley scored a composed century to help Griqualand West to 263 for seven on the first day of the four-day Supersport series match against Western Province in Kimberley on Friday.
Gidley's 117 held Griquas together after they were inserted by Western Province and were reduced to 38 for two by the visitors' vaunted all-international pace attack.
He shared an 83-run third-wicket partnership with Willie Dry (31) to repair the early damage and then put on 72 for the fourth wicket with Ralph Koster (26) to blunt the Province quintet.
Gidley was finally sixth man lbw to a ball which kept low from Craig Matthews after a six-hour 51-minute stay which included 10 fours from his 291 balls.
WP's slow bowling rate meant that play went on just over an hour after the scheduled close at 6pm.
Bowling: Schultz 22-5-63-2, Pringle 26-7-69-2, Matthews 21-5-46-2, Simons 14-4-34-0, Kallis 14-5-31-1, Koenig 7-3-11-0
